problem: Tucker regression: Y=<X,A>+epsilon; arbitrary prescribed L.
method: Pilot debiasing, subspace updates, tangent projection.
assumptions: Correct-rank pilot, subspace accuracy; regression Thm 3.1 explicitly lambda_min>=c>0; loading and remainder conditions.
asymptotic_regime: Three modes grow; rank/sample/SNR restrictions.
rate_or_guarantee: Normal approximation at sigma*||P_T L||/sqrt(n); plug-in variance and interval lower bound.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Strong fixed stratum -> entire rank-cap union, including A_n approaching its boundary. Lower bound is not a solution to union honesty.
classification: Same functional problem; harder parameter class.
evidence: Full text: assumptions, method, main inference and lower-bound statements.

problem: Matrix factor model with noisy observed entries and an unobserved target M_11.
method: Signal-strength-dependent estimation; testing and CI lower bounds.
assumptions: Bounded entries; rank-one and nested rank-one/rank-two classes; Gaussian benchmark.
asymptotic_regime: N,T grow; factor magnitude may be weak.
rate_or_guarantee: Rank-one length order min{1,sqrt(N+T)/a}, a=signal norm; nonshrinking honest intervals on strong submodels under larger-union coverage.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Missing target, fixed entry noise -> fully observed tensor with shrinking noise. Generic honesty/adaptation conflict is already established.
classification: Same statistical obstruction, different experiment.
evidence: Full text: first-part construction, lower bounds and adaptation theorems.

problem: Y_it=X_it M_it+E_it; block averages of low-rank matrix M.
method: Diverse projections of dimension R>=r and two bias corrections.
assumptions: Bounded r,R; independent errors/weights; nondegenerate projection alignment; log N << s_min(beta); block-size conditions.
asymptotic_regime: N,T grow; factors may be weaker than conventional pervasive factors.
rate_or_guarantee: Studentized block-average CLT without estimating exact rank.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Unknown exact rank already handled. Remaining proposal permits singular values down to zero and general L in joint tensor varieties.
classification: Same estimator family/new regime only if quantitatively harder.
evidence: Full text: model, bias correction, complete main assumption list and CLT.

problem: Panel Y=X beta+sum Z_k delta_k+Gamma+U; rank(Gamma)<=R.
method: Minimax linear weights plus nuclear-norm bias bound.
assumptions: Rank cap; design noncollinearity; conditional independent errors, moments and weight regularity; no minimum factor strength.
asymptotic_regime: N,T grow; balanced and unbalanced panels.
rate_or_guarantee: Uniform bias-aware coverage; beta error O_p(1/min(N,T)).
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Target is regression coefficient with low-rank nuisance. A tensor extension must improve the sharp functional bias/length frontier, not merely reuse bias correction.
classification: Same weak-rank inference mechanism, different target.
evidence: Full text: estimator, coverage theorem, primitive sufficient conditions.

problem: Gaussian sequence/white-noise linear functional over nested parameter classes.
method: Ordered/between-class moduli; testing; adaptive interval constructions.
assumptions: General classes for lower bound; convex-class structure for principal matching upper results.
asymptotic_regime: Noise precision n grows; nonparametric classes.
main_theorem: Thm 1, PDF p. 6; upper-bound results in Sections 3–5.
rate_or_guarantee: Expected length bounded below by between-class modulus at constant/sqrt(n).
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: A cone or two-point bound alone is inherited. Need sharp upper/lower results for nonconvex, continuously indexed tensor unions and varying geometry.
classification: Same inferential objective in classical form.
evidence: Full text: modulus definitions, lower theorem, scope of upper constructions.

problem: Structured regression with nonidentity design covariance; Tucker specialization.
method: Covariance-weighted tangent projection and feasible one-step inference.
assumptions: C1 embedded manifold; independent consistent pilot; covariance/projection rates; Tucker Assumption 5 imposes lambda>=c>0.
asymptotic_regime: General manifold theorem plus growing-dimensional Tucker conditions.
rate_or_guarantee: Normal variance sigma^2*||Phi(L)||_Sigma^2/N; local minimax length lower bound.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Correlated-design regular inference already covered; regular manifold -> nonregular union remains the relevant change.
classification: Same problem and theory for covariance-only extension.
evidence: Full PDF read online; accepted preprint updated 2026-09-08.

problem: Linear functional g^T x with x in a finite union of convex compact sets; indirect Gaussian and other observation schemes.
method: Pairwise convex optimization and aggregation; also N-convex function recovery.
assumptions: Explicit finitely many convex compact sets, affine observation maps, good observation scheme.
asymptotic_regime: Finite-sample confidence tolerance; number I of sets controls the comparison cost.
rate_or_guarantee: High-probability error <=rho_i on class i; near-minimax epsilon-risk with logarithmic-in-I sample overhead.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Finite convex unions -> continuously parameterized tensor subspaces. Discretization may already yield the desired rate and must be checked; high-probability estimation bounds also yield honest intervals.
classification: Same functional problem and a serious generic construction.
evidence: Full text: model, convex programs, Propositions 3.1–3.2, and their near-optimality comparison.

problem: Y=mathcal X(M)+Z under atomic low-dimensional structure, including matrices.
method: Atomic-norm estimation and geometric debiasing.
assumptions: Gaussian/RIP-type design; noise and geometric sample-size conditions; no universal beta-min requirement.
asymptotic_regime: Ambient dimension grows; geometric complexity controlled.
rate_or_guarantee: Gaussian low-dimensional component plus bounded bias; matrix Frobenius error <=constant*sigma*sqrt(r(p+q)/n).
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Generic rank-free debiasing is known. Convex descent geometry does not itself establish sharp intervals on the nonconvex tensor union.
classification: Same linear-inverse inference framework.
evidence: Full text: debiasing theorem and matrix corollary.

problem: Gaussian trace regression for rank<=r matrices.
method: Iterative hard thresholding using cap K>=2r, followed by debiasing.
assumptions: RIP; bounded norm; sufficiently large n; no singular-value separation.
asymptotic_regime: d,n grow; sufficient entrywise condition max(K^2 d,K d log d)=o(n).
rate_or_guarantee: Rank-adaptive estimation and explicit Gaussian limiting law with vanishing entrywise remainder.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Weak-rank normal inference is not new. Joint tensor constraints and optimal union-honest length are additional demands.
classification: Same inference claim already in matrices.
evidence: Full text: algorithm, theorem assumptions and limiting distribution.

problem: Matrix completion; confidence sets for whole bounded low-rank matrix.
method: Residual/U-statistic loss estimation and testing-based adaptation.
assumptions: Sampling scheme, bounded entries/noise, variance knowledge matter.
asymptotic_regime: Matrix dimensions and rank grow with sample size.
rate_or_guarantee: Adaptive normalized Frobenius diameter squared ~k(m1+m2)/n up to logs in positive regimes; impossibility in specified unknown-variance Bernoulli regimes.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Whole-matrix Frobenius sets -> scalar length. Do not transfer the impossibility to all sampling models or all functionals.
classification: Same rank-adaptive UQ, different loss/experiment.
evidence: Full text: both observation models and positive/negative theorems.

problem: Noisy matrix completion; psi=<L,M>.
method: Sample splitting, debiasing and rank projection.
assumptions: Incoherence, correct-rank pilot, signal lower bound, loading alignment and negligible remainders.
asymptotic_regime: Rectangular dimensions, ranks and n may grow.
rate_or_guarantee: CLT with variance sigma^2*d1*d2/n*(||LV||_F^2+||U^T L||_F^2) in the stated regime.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Separated fixed rank -> unknown/weak joint tensor rank; matrix functional inference itself is solved.
classification: Same statistical problem; different structure/regime.
evidence: Full text: signal/loading conditions, estimator and CLT.

problem: Tucker signal plus independent heteroskedastic sub-Gaussian noise.
method: HOOI with initialization; perturbation expansions; estimated variances.
assumptions: Incoherence/conditioning; SNR lambda/sigma >=constant*p^(3/4)*sqrt(log p); further rank and entry alignment restrictions.
asymptotic_regime: Comparable mode sizes p grow.
rate_or_guarantee: Row expansion, entrywise studentized CLT, confidence intervals and efficiency results.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Heteroskedastic inference above a signal threshold -> full union including below-threshold sequences.
classification: Same tensor inference line, stronger noise coverage already known.
evidence: Full text: expansion, CLT, feasible inference and lower-bound statements.

problem: Tucker PCA/regression; subspaces, rank-one entries and linear forms.
method: Two iterations of alternating minimization; no explicit debiasing.
assumptions: Accurate initializer; conditioning and rank restrictions; strong enough SNR.
asymptotic_regime: PCA: (pr)^(3/4)/(lambda/sigma)->0, r^3/p->0 under bounded conditioning.
rate_or_guarantee: Normal limits for scaled subspace losses; regression analogue with explicit n/SNR remainders.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Subspace inference with detectable singular directions -> functional CI over unidentified/weak directions.
classification: Same tensor application; partly different estimand.
evidence: Full text: PCA and regression theorem statements and initialization conditions.

problem: Gaussian matrix trace regression; low-rank testing and confidence sets.
method: Detection lower/upper bounds and reduction from confidence sets.
assumptions: Gaussian isotropic design/noise; rank restrictions; PSD constraint changes conclusions.
asymptotic_regime: d,n grow; small-rank alternatives.
main_theorem: Thm 1 and confidence-set consequences; PDF pp. 4–9.
rate_or_guarantee: Frobenius detection radius min{sqrt(d/n),n^(-1/4)}; nuclear radius has sqrt(k) factor.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Matrix detection is an essential lower-bound baseline. It is not a blanket impossibility theorem for scalar functional intervals.
classification: Same adaptation/testing mechanism.
evidence: Full text: metric-specific detection and confidence-set results.

problem: Likelihood models, including irregular parameter spaces.
method: Split likelihood ratio; invert tests and profile nuisance parameters.
assumptions: Correct likelihood and independent split; finite-sample validity needs no smooth manifold.
asymptotic_regime: Finite sample; regular-model diameter theorem separately requires fixed dimension and a consistent pilot.
rate_or_guarantee: Coverage >=1-alpha exactly; regular diameter O_p(sqrt(log(1/alpha)/n)).
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Rank-boundary coverage existence already follows. Sharp tensor functional length and tractable safe profiling remain separate questions.
classification: Same generic honest inference guarantee.
evidence: Full text HTML: theorem statements, proof of coverage, profiling and safe bounds.

problem: Optimization on bounded Tucker-rank tensor varieties.
method: Explicit Bouligand cone parameterization; projected and rank-adaptive optimization.
assumptions: Deterministic finite-dimensional multilinear algebra.
asymptotic_regime: No statistical asymptotics.
rate_or_guarantee: Tangent cone characterization; all-ranks-slack stationarity forces ambient gradient zero.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Discovering the Tucker cone is solved. Statistical testing complexity and achievable interval length are not supplied.
classification: Same geometry; different statistical objective.
evidence: Full text: cone theorem and rank-deficient stationarity proposition.

problem: Tensor-train bounded-rank varieties, including singular points.
method: Block TT representation of all tangent directions.
assumptions: Feasible rank vectors and gauge/orthogonality conditions.
asymptotic_regime: Deterministic finite dimension.
rate_or_guarantee: Exact tangent-cone representation and orthogonal decomposition.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: TT cone -> statistically sharp support/modulus and CI construction. Replacing Tucker notation with TT is insufficient.
classification: Same deterministic problem already solved.
evidence: Full text: cone representation and surrounding conditions.

problem: Likelihood-ratio tests at singularities of algebraic statistical models.
method: Chernoff tangent-cone asymptotics.
assumptions: Regular ambient model; Chernoff-regular null; consistent restricted MLE.
asymptotic_regime: Fixed parameter dimension; fixed true point.
rate_or_guarantee: Limit is squared Gaussian distance to the Fisher-transformed tangent cone.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Pointwise fixed-dimensional limit -> uniform moving-boundary/high-dimensional functional intervals. Plugging in a selected cone is not justified.
classification: Same singular-likelihood mechanism.
evidence: Full text: regularity conditions, theorem and singular examples.

problem: Spiked matrix factor/covariance/Wigner/CCA models; signal strengths.
method: Transition-aware random-matrix distribution approximations.
assumptions: Specified noise models; finite spikes; distinct fixed others in the cited critical theorem.
asymptotic_regime: Thm 4.6: one spike theta_c+N^(-1/3)h; eigenvalue scale N^(-2/3).
rate_or_guarantee: Uniform treatment connecting subcritical/critical behavior to supercritical Gaussian inference.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Weak/strong transition is known in matrices; spike-strength target -> prescribed tensor linear functional. Does not automatically cover colliding arbitrary spikes.
classification: Same nonstandard regime, different estimand.
evidence: Full text: critical transition theorem and restrictions.

problem: Symmetric order-three CP tensor completion from Bernoulli entries.
method: Spectral initialization and nonconvex gradient estimation; residual variance estimation.
assumptions: Incoherent, well-conditioned CP factors; sample/SNR restrictions; target-entry strength condition; independent heteroskedastic noise.
asymptotic_regime: Tensor size grows; fixed or controlled rank.
rate_or_guarantee: Studentized entry/factor CLTs and confidence intervals; Gaussian unbiased-estimator variance lower bounds.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: CP rank and entrywise completion -> joint Tucker/TT rank-union functional inference. Noise robustness is already covered.
classification: Same tensor inference application, different rank/target regime.
evidence: Full 2020 author manuscript: assumptions, CI theorems and scope of lower bound; 2023 journal metadata verified.
